tours.name: Camel Ride
tours.short_description: Immerse yourself in Bedouin culture as you take a leisurely journey through the stunning Dubai desert with an Arabian camel.
tours.about: Immerse yourself in Bedouin culture as you take a leisurely journey through the stunning Dubai desert with an Arabian camel.
tours.full_description:
A ride on an Arabian camel is an unforgettable introduction of desert life and Bedouin culture. Our Camel Ride experience offers an incredible morning with one of Arabia’s greatest companions, complete with wildlife spotting and a tranquil lakeside stop.

Your experience will begin with pick-up from your hotel or residence in Dubai and a drive to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve (DDCR) in an air-conditioned 4x4 vehicle.

Here, you will first meet the majestic Arabian camel that will transport you across the desert on a breathtaking journey through the DDCR’s beautiful rolling dunes.

Led by an expert camel shepherd at a calm, steady pace, you’ll have plenty of time to spot the fascinating wildlife that inhabits the desert while capturing plenty of Instagram-worthy photo opportunities.

After a picturesque 45-minute ride, you’ll reach our designated breakfast spot. At this peaceful location, you’ll enjoy delightful views of the sun glistening over the desert.

After breakfast, you have the option of either taking the return 45-minute camel ride back through the desert or be collected from your breakfast stop and driven back to your hotel or residence.

tours.pickup_information: Hotel or residence pick-up included from anywhere in Dubai

Shared or private transfer
Camel ride
Breakfast box
Bubbles or date juice
Wildlife
Bird watching
Lakeside stop
Photo opportunity
tours.know_before_you_go:
In the summer months, this tour operates in the afternoon
We recommend wearing comfortable clothing and walking shoes for this activity. As you will be spending time in the desert, we also suggest wearing suncream, and bringing sunglasses and a hat
While we endeavour to show you as much wildlife as possible, we cannot predict the movements of every species. Therefore, if some of the animals change their plans, we can’t guarantee you’ll spot them
We will work to accommodate special dietary requirements when they are shared with us in advance. Please contact our team via WhatsApp to share your requirements, or complete a contact form
We do not recommend this activity for expectant mothers, or guests who have a history of heart ailments, back or neck problems
Restrooms are available during this activity
tours.age_policy:
The following age brackets apply for booking purposes:
Adults: 12 years old and above
Children: 5-11 years old
Infants: Below 5 years old
The minimum age to join the Camel Ride is 3 years old. Children under the age of 11 must be accompanied by an adult throughout the experience
A private vehicle must be booked for infants or those under 135cm height. Details must be shared with our team at the time of booking
tours.cancellation_policy:
We understand that plans can change. If they do, please let us know at least 24 hours prior to your activity. We will not be able to process refunds for bookings cancelled less than 24 hours before your activity starts
Full payment for your booking is required at least two days prior to your activity. If payment is not received before the expected date, we reserve the right to cancel your activity
In exceptional circumstances, we may have to amend the Camel Ride schedule or cancel the activity entirely. We reserve the right to amend and cancel activities in such circumstances, and will ensure we communicate any changes in advance where possible
tours.additional_notes: In the summer months, this tour operates in the afternoon.

tours.name: Exclusive Desert Experience
tours.short_description: Escape to your own private Bedouin-inspired dining space for a dining experience in the heart of the desert.
tours.about: Escape to your own private Bedouin-inspired dining space for a dining experience in the heart of the desert. Secluded and atmospheric, this experience offers an incredible, unique space for couples celebrating an anniversary, a family coming together for a birthday, or friends gathering to enjoy a special evening together.
tours.full_description:
The Exclusive Desert Experience is a secluded, curated dining experience nestled in the heart of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve (DDCR). Privacy and exclusivity are central to your itinerary, and the surrounding landscapes provide an idyllic backdrop for your evening of delicious dining and shared moments together.

Your journey begins with a private transfer from your accommodation in Dubai to the DDCR. You will be picked up by one of our friendly and knowledgeable guides in an air-conditioned 4x4 vehicle and enjoy a comfortable journey to the desert.

From here, it’s time to drive across the beautiful rolling desert dunes as your dedicated guide helps you spot a range of local wildlife. You’ll then get the opportunity to enjoy a short ride on an Arabian camel and further admire the stunning desert landscape.

Then, still in the exclusive company of your group, you’ll be taken to a secluded location to admire a breathtaking desert sunset. Here, you can take time to bask in the beauty of this incredible spectacle.

After the sun has set, your Bedouin-inspired dining space is waiting for you. Unlimited soft drinks are included as part of your package, with premium beverages and shisha available if you wish. To round off an incredible trip to the desert, you’ll have time to stargaze under the mesmerising blanket of stars above you.

Your return transfer will also be in complete privacy, with one of our experts driving you back from the camp.

tours.know_before_you_go:
A private outing for up to six guests.
Choose breathable clothes, sturdy footwear, sunscreen, sunglasses and a hat; desert evenings can turn cold.
Share dietary and health needs in advance. Pregnancy or existing medical conditions exclude dune driving; other activities may remain possible.
Wildlife sightings are unpredictable. Campsite restrooms are available.
Adult-beverage service may change on religious dates.
Background music is provided. Live shows are extra arrangements available on request.
An overnight extension can be requested.
tours.age_policy:
Booking bands: adults 12+, children 5-11, infants under 5.
A private vehicle is required for children aged 2-5 or anyone shorter than 135 cm; share details when booking.
tours.cancellation_policy:
Give at least 24 hours notice; later cancellations are non-refundable.
Payment is due two days before departure. Unpaid bookings can be cancelled.
Exceptional circumstances may require rescheduling or cancellation; changes are communicated beforehand when possible.

tours.name: The Veuve Clicquot Desert Experience
tours.short_description: The Veuve Clicquot Desert Experience is a first-of-its-kind evening of premium dining underneath the Dubai sunset.
tours.about: The Veuve Clicquot Desert Experience is a first-of-its-kind evening of premium dining underneath the Dubai sunset. The centrepiece of the experience is a multi-course menu, served alongside a selection of premium beverages specifically matched to each course, hosted by your personal chef and sommelier in a secluded corner of the desert. This experience brings together the natural beauty of the desert dunes and the exclusivity of private dining in a truly spectacular setting.
tours.full_description:
The Veuve Clicquot Desert Experience by Arabian Adventures is a first-of its kind evening of premium dining in the Dubai desert. The experience is inspired by the world of exclusive dining and the natural beauty of the desert, aligning both elements to create an incredible night underneath the sunset.

This experience is inspired by the concept of exclusivity. Throughout your evening, there are so many moments to enjoy for yourself and your group, whether it's the multi-course menu prepared and served by your private chef, your bespoke dining space that’s private to you and your party of guests, or simply the moments you will share together.

The evening’s setting is a bespoke dining space, tucked away in a secluded corner of the desert. After guests take a moment to relax at the Sundowner Lounge with a glass of sparkling bubbles, a Bedouin-inspired dining area will play host to the remainder of the evening. The Sundowner Lounge can be reached by a short camel trek upon arrival, and is the perfect place to set the chilled, serene atmosphere for the remainder of the evening.

The multi-course menu of the Veuve Clicquot Desert Experience is crafted by a private chef, with the menu itself elevated by a selection of premium beverages chosen to enhance every dish with their own unique flavour profiles. A personal sommelier will also be on hand to demonstrate how the characteristics of each beverage align perfectly with every plate.

Throughout the evening, you will have the opportunity to take in the world around you and delight your senses with the aromas of your food, the alignment between plate and glass, the sound of silence across the desert plains, and the feeling of experiencing something that's truly out of the ordinary.

The Veuve Clicquot Desert Experience is available for groups of up to eight guests. Whether you enjoy this experience as a couple for an anniversary, a food lover or wine connoisseur seeking premium dining away from the usual restaurant setting, a group of friends celebrating a special occasion, this incredible evening will be sure to meet and exceed any expectations you had about dining in the desert.

A one-of-a-kind experience shared with your group of guests
A multi-course menu prepared by a private chef
A selection of premium beverages specially paired to your dining menu and served by a private sommelier
A bespoke dining space in a secluded corner of the desert
A special Veuve Clicquot playlist to create a serene atmosphere
Incredible sunset views from the Sundowner Lounge
tours.know_before_you_go:
This experience is exclusive to your party only, with space to comfortably accommodate up to eight guests
Guests have access to nearby restrooms throughout the evening
Please let our team know about any dietary requirements in your group at least 48 hours prior to your experience
A portion of the Veuve Clicquot Experience fee will be donated to supporting local conservation projects in the DDCR
tours.age_policy: The Veuve Clicquot Desert Experience is for guests aged 21 and above.
tours.cancellation_policy: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours prior to your experience for a full refund. If a cancellation is made within 48 hours of the scheduled experience, a 100% no-show fee will be applied.
tours.additional_notes: Guests must be aged 21 or above. Please share dietary requirements at least 48 hours before the experience.

tours.name: Morning Desert Adventure & Hot Air Balloon Combo
tours.short_description: Take your Morning Desert Adventure to another level and add a hot air balloon experience to your spectacular early start.
tours.about: Take your Morning Desert Adventure to another level and add a hot air balloon experience to your spectacular early start. As the city starts to wake, you'll head to the skies and take the perfect vantage point for a desert sunrise. After your hot air balloon experience, you will take to the dunes for a full itinerary of activities throughout the morning, including a thrilling dune drive, peaceful camel trek, wildlife spotting opportunities and breakfast in the desert.
tours.full_description:
A Morning Desert Adventure showcases the natural wonder that the desert brings.

This experience is a spectacular break from the morning routine and includes unforgettable activities you will always remember, including a hot air balloon ride over the desert at sunrise and a range of activities that will bring you closer to the magic of the dunes.

Starting before daybreak, the Morning Desert Adventure begins with the trip of a lifetime on a Hero hot air balloon.

Hero Air Balloon are specialists in immersive, one-of-a-kind experiences, and their exclusive access to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve provides guests with incredible views across some of the most captivating landscapes in the world.

You will take in the desert sunrise from a truly unique vantage point when you start the day with this phenomenal activity.

Once you have seen one of the world’s best sunrises, you will be transferred to the starting point of your Morning Desert Adventure.

A thrilling dune drive follows, where you'll feel every element of the rugged desert terrain as we take you up, down and across the dunes.

The camel ride and sandboarding sessions are both calming and thrilling and are unique experiences you’ll only be able to enjoy in the desert.

Breakfast on the dunes is included as part of your adventure, so you can enjoy a once-in-a-lifetime first meal of the day.

Throughout your Morning Desert Adventure, there will be plenty of opportunities to spot the local wildlife that call the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve their home.

Please note: For pickups from Abu Dhabi, Ras al Khaimah, Umm al Quwain, Al Ain, and Fujairah, private vehicle bookings will be subject to an AED 200 surcharge per vehicle, and shared vehicle bookings will be subject to an AED 200 surcharge per booking.
tours.image_alt: Couple enjoying breakfast at a desert dining table
tours.pickup_information: Transfers to and from the Morning Desert Adventure from your hotel or residence.
tours.highlights:
A thrilling dune drive through the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve
Walking across the dunes on an Arabian Camel
Enjoying a breakfast box underneath the morning sunshine
Spotting the native wildlife of the DDCR roaming through their natural habitat
Surfing the dunes during an optional sandboarding session
Spectacular views along the horizon from your hot air balloon

This experience is a spectacular break from the morning routine and includes unforgettable activities you will always remember, including a hot air balloon ride over the desert at sunrise and a range of activities that will bring you closer to the magic of the dunes.
Starting before daybreak, the Morning Desert Adventure begins with the trip of a lifetime on a Hero hot air balloon.

Hero Air Balloon are specialists in immersive, one-of-a-kind experiences, and their exclusive access to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve provides guests with incredible views across some of the most captivating landscapes in the world.
You will take in the desert sunrise from a truly unique vantage point when you start the day with this phenomenal activity.
Once you have seen one of the world’s best sunrises, you will be transferred to the starting point of your Morning Desert Adventure.
A thrilling dune drive follows, where you'll feel every element of the rugged desert terrain as we take you up, down and across the dunes.
The camel ride and sandboarding sessions are both calming and thrilling and are unique experiences you’ll only be able to enjoy in the desert.
Breakfast on the dunes is included as part of your adventure, so you can enjoy a once-in-a-lifetime first meal of the day.
Throughout your Morning Desert Adventure, there will be plenty of opportunities to spot the local wildlife that call the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve their home.

tours.name: Wadi Adventures
tours.short_description: Discover the beauty of the UAE spanning far beyond the desert.
tours.about: Discover the beauty of the UAE spanning far beyond the desert. Away from the dunes and the downtown lights, there’s a world of incredible natural wonder that can only be found by those who set out to discover it. Rugged mountains, hidden pools, and a day of breathtaking scenery await on a Wadi Adventure.
tours.full_description:
There are so many hidden gems to be found across the UAE, with many discovered when spending a day on a Wadi Adventure. When you head out of the city and into the country, you will find stunning mountainous landscapes that are eye-catching and breathtaking in equal measure. What’s more, there’s an array of historical sites that tell the story of the UAE, from a time long before how it currently looks today.

The Wadi Adventure tour is a memorable adventure that uncovers the natural beauty of the UAE. Starting from your hotel or residence, the tour takes you on a trip across some of the most beautiful, cultural and enriching sights the country offers.

The tour begins in Sharjah, at Fossil Rock. Owing to its name, Fossil Rock is a landmark where fossils millions of years old can be held in your hands. This first stop of the tour sets the tone for the rest of your journey, as there is vast outstanding beauty and incredible heritage to be discovered here.

From here, the tour continues to the Mleiha Archaeological Centre, where the country’s caves, wadis and archaeological sites are showcased across an eye-catching exhibition. There will be plenty of photo opportunities available at Wadi Shawka Pools, before heading across to Buhais Geology Park.

Buhais Geology Park is an education centre assembled next to a series of tombs and other historical landmarks. Here, you will find remnants of the country’s ancient past, and signs of civilisation from many centuries ago. A scenic drive over to Wadi Helo for a leisurely exploration will then follow, on our way to the East Coast of the UAE for a picturesque lunch stop.

The Wadi Adventures tour is for lovers of history, nature, and experiencing the path less travelled. While the bright lights of downtown and the golden sandy beaches are Dubai’s signature appeal, a day away from the mainstream will leave you feeling charmed and enriched.
